description: Python library and MCP server implementing 80+ startup valuation formulas (Scorecard, Berkus, VC Method, DCF, CAPM/WACC, Black-Scholes, comparables, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, biotech rNPV, SAFE conversion) as 14 read-only, deterministic MCP tools.
rules: Install with `pip install 'startup-valuation[mcp]'`; run the stdio server with `startup-valuation-mcp` or `uvx --from startup-valuation startup-valuation-mcp`.
The hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint is https://startup-valuation.simonmak.com/api and needs no API key.
All 14 MCP tools (`valuation_*`) are pure arithmetic: read-only, idempotent, no I/O; results are rounded to 2 decimal places.
Each tool is a dispatcher: pass a `method` plus that method's parameters; unknown methods or missing required parameters return an error.

Use `valuation_core` for pre-revenue methods (Scorecard, Berkus, Risk-Factor Summation, VC Method), `valuation_probability` for expected-value lists, and `valuation_advanced` for options and scenarios.
